from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal, List

class CaseInfo(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single legal document for classification."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The official title of the legal document, including book title marks")
    case_cause: Literal[
        '渎职罪',
        '行政行为 - 行政给付',
        '刑事赔偿',
        '知识产权与竞争',
        '执行案由 - 行政非诉执行',
        '行政行为 - 行政补偿'
    ] = Field(description="The legal cause category determined from the document content")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cases: List[CaseInfo]
